info.title: Money Planner API
info.description: Everything except `/health` and `/auth` needs a signed-in user: send the session token as `Authorization: Bearer`, or let the browser send the session cookie. Most endpoints work inside a space: pick it with the `X-Space-Id` header (a space the user belongs to); without the header it is the first space of the user. Amounts are integers in the minor unit of their currency (12.34 PLN is 1234).

get.description: Returns ok while the server is running.

post.description: Always answers 204, whether or not the address has an account. The e-mail has a link (opened in the browser app) and a 6-digit code (typed in the mobile app), valid for 15 minutes.
post.summary: E-mail a sign-in link and code

post.description: Creates the account on the first sign-in. A code stops working after 5 wrong tries.
post.summary: Sign in with the code from the e-mail
Sign in with the token from the e-mailed link

post.description: The app signs in with Google and sends the ID token it got. The token has to be for one of this server's Google client ids and its e-mail address verified by Google. Creates the account on the first sign-in; an account with the same address is the same account.
post.summary: Sign in with a Google ID token

post.description: For the browser app, which gets an access token from Google's popup instead of an ID token. The server asks Google whom the token was issued to and refuses one that was not issued to one of its client ids or whose address Google has not verified. Otherwise the same as the ID token sign-in.
post.summary: Sign in with a Google access token

put.summary: Set the name other members see

post.description: The token stops working at once and the cookie is cleared.

get.description: The personal space first, then the shared ones in the order the user joined them.
Chosen by the `X-Space-Id` header, the user's personal space when it is missing.
get.summary: Get the space of this request

put.description: Owners only. The default currency only applies to what is created afterwards.

delete.description: Owners only, and only when nobody else is a member: remove the others first.
delete.summary: Delete a shared space with all its data

put.description: Owners only. A space keeps at least one owner.
put.summary: Change the role of a member

delete.description: Owners only. What the member added stays, marked as by a former member.

post.description: The last owner has to hand over the role first.
Owners only, to shared spaces. The address gets an e-mail and sees the invitation once signed in with it. Inviting an address again renews its invitation and sets the new role.

get.description: Owners only: those waiting for an answer and those waiting for approval.
get.summary: List the open invitations of a space

delete.summary: Revoke an invitation, or turn down an accepted one

post.description: Owners only. The person becomes a member.
post.summary: Let in somebody who accepted an invitation

get.description: Only those still waiting for my answer.

post.description: Does not give access yet: an owner of the space has to approve it, and is told by e-mail.

delete.description: Fails with 409 while any envelope still uses the category. Owners of the space only.

post.description: Creates the period together with its initial envelopes.

get.description: The period with the latest start date.

put.description: Changes the name and dates. Use the plan endpoint for money.

delete.description: Also deletes its envelopes and expenses. Owners of the space only.

put.description: A zero amount removes the envelope, or keeps it at zero when it already has expenses. Send the `version` of the period the edit is based on: if somebody else changed the plan meanwhile the answer is 409 and nothing is saved.

post.summary: Add an envelope to a period

get.description: Newest first. Defaults to 50 rows, at most 200.
get.summary: List the expenses of a period

get.description: Newest first. One call instead of one per period.
get.summary: Planned and spent for every period

get.description: Totals for the period and for each envelope.

get.summary: List what was paid into a period

post.description: In the name of the signed-in user, or of nobody with `external`. The planned income of the period is a separate number.
post.summary: Record money paid into a period

delete.description: Whoever recorded it, or an owner of the space. Money from outside has no author, so only an owner deletes it.

put.description: Setting `active` to false pauses the rule.

delete.description: Expenses it already generated are kept.

get.description: Sum of the active rules in one currency per category, to prefill a new period's plan.

post.description: Adds one expense for every active rule not applied in this period yet, creating a missing envelope with the rule's amount as its plan. Safe to call repeatedly.
post.summary: Apply recurring rules to a period

get.description: A full snapshot as JSON, with ids and timestamps.

post.description: Row counts of the document next to the current data. Changes nothing.
Replaces ALL current data with the document, in one transaction. Owners of the space only.
Converts the old local format (integer ids, amounts in zloty) and replaces ALL current data. Owners of the space only.
post.summary: Import a backup of the offline app

get.description: Columns: Period, Category, Amount, Date, Note.

post.description: Creates missing periods and categories by name and skips rows that already exist.

Role.description: `owner` manages the space and its members; `member` works with the budget.

Transport.description: `token` returns the session token in the response body (mobile apps); `cookie` sets it as an HTTP-only cookie instead (browser apps).
